messages:
Elaine: Hey team — PR up now: https://github.com/redwood/serving/pull/6580. This touches the runtime executor scheduling path and the helm chart for platform deploys. Requesting runtime (Priya), infra (Omar) and security (Sara) review. Hoping to merge in the 4:00pm PST merge window today. Any blockers? :wave:

Matt: Quick skim looks okay. Heads up: integration job is flaky locally for me, but unit tests pass. If CI is green we should be fine.

Priya: I can take the runtime bits. Main thing I'll check is KV cache keying (we changed the prefix logic). If you can add a tiny test that exercises prefix normalization that'd speed approval.

Elaine: Thanks — added a small unit test for prefix normalization and pushed a commit (see last commit). Also added a short changelog entry.

Omar: From infra side: manifest changes update instance type and add a new networkPolicy stanza. Need a short rolling-update plan for the cluster (we want to avoid simultaneous evict on dedicated pools). Also ensure there is a restart strategy in helm values (RollingUpdate). I can approve once there's a documented restart strategy and a note in the release notes.

Elaine: Added restart strategy and release note. Helm snippet I added:```yaml
controller:
  lifecycle:
    restartPolicy: RollingUpdate
  resources:
    limits:
      cpu: 4
      memory: 8Gi
```

Sara: Security quick check: are we introducing any new secret keys or env vars that would be templated into the chart? If so we need to ensure they come from KMS-backed SecretStore and run secret-scan before merge. If not, I can do a quick review.

CI-Bot: CI status: unit-tests ✅, integration-tests ❌ (failing test_kv_eviction). Rerun recommended.

Matt: I hit the same flaky locally. I'll re-run CI now.

Noah: If infra + security give thumbs up I can merge at 16:00 PST. Calling out merge window for visibility.

Priya: Reviewed the runtime change — left one small comment about normalizing trailing slashes in cache keys (tiny helper). After that I can approve.

Elaine: Pushed fix for the trailing-slash normalization and updated the test. @Priya @Omar @Sara can you re-ack when you get a sec? :pray:

Omar: Ack from infra. I also added a line to release-notes.md reminding ops about draining strategy for dedicated pools. :thumbsup:

Sara: Ran secret-scan on the branch (local). No new templated secrets detected. Security ack. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Re-reviewed and approved. Left one optional nits comment but not blocking. :shipit:

CI-Bot: CI rerun passed all jobs ✅✅

Noah: Merge scheduled for 16:00 PST. I'll merge and tag the rollout. Thanks everyone. :shipit:

Elaine: Thanks all — appreciate the quick reviews.
